neighbours.label: Words placing a part by orientation or level (horizontal, above, top, bottom, flat, rooftop) in physical descriptions of plants, anatomy and structures
fire: The gardener told us to snip each runner about two inches above the crown before replanting.
Hold the board level so the horizontal edge rests against the wall, then mark the studs.
In this species the stems creep along the ground as horizontal runners that root at every node.
Inside the old mill, a narrow stair climbs to the top of the grain chute.
Cut off the bottom end of the celery stalk and set it in a shallow dish of water.
The surgeon marked a flat plane across the specimen, parallel to the table.
A glass-walled lounge sits on the rooftop terrace, overlooking the harbor.
Bats cling to the ceiling, with their feet hooked over a ledge just above the entrance.
quiet: The gardener told us to snip each runner carefully before replanting it in fresh compost.
Hold the board steady so the edge rests firmly against the wall, then mark the studs.
In this species the stems spread quickly through the soil and root again at every node.
Inside the old mill, a narrow stair climbs past the dusty wheel and the grain chute.
Trim the celery stalk with a sharp knife and set it in a shallow dish of cold water.
The surgeon examined the specimen closely, comparing it with the sample on the table.
A glass-walled lounge sits beside the garden terrace, with views of the busy harbor.
Bats cling to the ceiling in dense clusters, wary of any light near the entrance.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strong activations are a mix: spatial orientation/level words (horizontal x7, above, top, bottom, flat) in botany, anatomy and construction text, plus oddities like 'terminates in' and 'close to'; weak mass is scattered subword pieces. The - pole fires on inside/outside/sides/shaft/hollow, so this looks like the vertical/orientation half of a part-location distinction, but coverage by the word list is only a few percent.
